title: SJP Ultrasonic IPO Details
intro:
SJP Ultrasonic IPO is a fixed issue price of ₹23.45 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 35.00 lakh shares of ₹23.45 crore.

SJP Ultrasonic IPO opens for subscription on Sep 30, 2026 and closes on Oct 5, 2026. The allotment for the SJP Ultrasonic IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 6, 2026. SJP Ultrasonic IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 8, 2026.

SJP Ultrasonic IPO is set final issue price at ₹67 per share. The lot size for an application is 2,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,68,000 (4,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (6,000 shares), amounting to ₹4,02,000.

Khandwala Securities Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Aftertrade Broking Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to SJP Ultrasonic IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated on January 27, 2012, SJP Ultrasonic Ltd. is engaged in the end-to-end plastic joining and automation solution providers. The company offers specialised solutions mainly in the Automotive industry and industries related to Medical, Electrical, Electronics, Textile, FMCG, Toys, Gift & Stationery, Food & Packaging, Defence & Educational Institutes. The sale of the products and services is majorly made to manufacturers engaged in various industries, which makes model business to business (B2B).

The manufacturing facility is situated at Gala No. 1 and Gala No. 2, Shiv Shankar Industrial Complex 2, Bhutpada, Building No.5, Opp. Golden Chariot Hotel, Highway, Vasai East, Palghar - 401 208, Maharashtra, India.

The company intends to enhance in-house manufacturing capabilities and increasing production efficiency by purchasing Milling Machines, CNC Lathe Machine, Compressor, CNC Bandsaw Machine, Overhead Crane, 6 Axis Robot, Co2 Laser Cutting Unit, Computers, NX Softwares, Solid Works Software, Diesel Generator, CMM Machine, Vibration Welders, Laser Plastic Welder to improve production.
As of March 31, 2026, the company had 84 employees.
strengths: A start to finish plastic welding solution provider offering diverse and comprehensive service offerings.
Long standing relations with raw material and equipment suppliers
Long-standing relationships with established customers, with potential to expand the customer base.
They provide a diverse range of specialised plastic products across varied industry segments

faqs.question: How to apply in SJP Ultrasonic IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in SJP Ultrasonic IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in SJP Ultrasonic IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in SJP Ultrasonic IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' SJP Ultrasonic IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: The SJP Ultrasonic IPO opens on Wed, Sep 30, 2026 and closes on Mon, Oct 5, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of SJP Ultrasonic IPO?
faqs.answer: SJP Ultrasonic IPO lot size is 2000 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,68,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for SJP Ultrasonic IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in SJP Ultrasonic IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is SJP Ultrasonic IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for SJP Ultrasonic IPO will be done on Tuesday, October 6, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Wed, Oct 7, 2026 . Check the SJP Ultrasonic IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The SJP Ultrasonic IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Thu, Oct 8, 2026 .
